checks.finding: No under- or over-classification found. No task touches auth/authz, payment, PII, or classic data migration (every Data Migration field reads 'none' or 'additive'); the seven Risk: high tasks (T-002, T-004, T-005, T-008, T-009, T-010, T-011) each cite a named Security Boundary (B1-B5) plus the policy's 'silent defect causes material harm' catch-all, with a well-reasoned Risk Rationale distinguishing them from T-001/T-003/T-006/T-007's medium classification. No high/critical task's scope is limited to UI copy/CSS/docs/trivial test-only content.

All seven Risk: high tasks carry a Done When item combining explicit Red (failing-fixture) and Green (correct-implementation) TDD evidence with 'An independent quality-gate verdict records PASS'. No Risk: critical task exists in this feature, so the second-approver/signed-evidence-bundle requirement does not apply.

T-004 ('Author the structural compatibility suite') Done When (tasks.md ~lines 679-704) lists 10 distinct checkable items, exceeding the >8-item oversized indicator. Its Scope (~lines 655-675) additionally spans at least 4-5 distinct implementation areas bundled into one task: the AST canonicalizer's three-step algorithm, the structural-fixture-corpus/v1 recording for F1/F2, authoring four separate named-SKIP assertions (F3/F4/F5/F6), and authoring a functionally separate, non-gating AC-031 live-model refresh test with its own new tests/structural-compatibility-live-refresh.tests.sh/.ps1 pair. The live-refresh suite is independently schedulable and does not share the gating suite's TDD Red/Green cycle.

T-006/T-007's deferred edge-case sub-cases are explicitly assigned to T-008, not silently omitted.

acceptance-tests.md's declared Test Type column consistently uses 'integration' only where the scope genuinely spans >=2 components, and reserves 'static / doc-review', 'static / schema', 'static / registration-forcing', and 'regression, byte-identical' for single-artifact or table-completeness checks. No test task's declared type mismatches its own stated scope.

All seven Risk: high tasks carry an explicit Rollback: field citing infra-spec.md#rollback: T-002 ('a bad initial capture is a straightforward git revert'), T-004, T-005, T-008, T-009, T-010 (manifest restore via git revert, fingerprint_match recomputed live so no cache to reconcile), and T-011 (including the human-copy-staging revert case for .github/workflows/test.yml).

Files edited by multiple tasks are properly sequenced via Depends On: tests/loop-consistency.tests.sh (T-006 -> T-008 -> T-010), tests/loop-escalation.tests.sh (T-007 -> T-008 -> T-010), tests/compatibility-byte-identical.tests.sh and tests/structural-compatibility.tests.sh (T-003/T-004 -> T-010). tests/run-all.sh/.ps1 is edited by five tasks but Global Constraints fixes a single explicit additive-only append rule covering all of them. The one instance where the exception is not satisfied (T-006/T-007 sharing tests/fixtures/compatibility-event-trace/) is reported under DEPENDENCY-OVERLAP to avoid duplicate findings.

T-007's own Planned Files entry (tasks.md ~line 1013) states tests/fixtures/compatibility-event-trace/ is '(existing after T-006, agent-editable -- golden-trace fixtures for the quality-gate-outcome and PROJECT_CONTEXT_INVALID stop event kinds)', i.e. T-007 explicitly depends on T-006 having already created this shared fixture directory. However T-007's Depends On field (~lines 1004-1006) lists only T-001 and T-005 -- T-006 is omitted -- and T-007's ### Blockers section also reads 'None' (~line 1089). An implementer or scheduler reading only the Depends On/Blockers fields could attempt T-007 before T-006 completes and find the fixture directory does not yet exist, causing an integration failure.
